content: Room migrations: missing migration path throws IllegalStateException at runtime; fallbackToDestructiveMigration silently wipes data. Auto-migrations require exportSchema=true + exported schema JSON of BOTH versions (Room Gradle plugin schemaDirectory). MigrationTestHelper validates schema after migration. Unique indexes resurface as SQLiteConstraintException on writes; unique index on youtubeUrl + OnConflictStrategy.IGNORE makes insert() return -1 silently.
